questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Gel ingredients work well on waved, curled, __relax and texture__ hair in the long run.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'relaxed and textured'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'relaxed and textured'** should be used instead of** 'relax and texture'.**
 
• The given sentence is in the **simple past tense.**
 
• Hence, all the verbs should be changed to** V₂**. 
 
 
• *Example: Lisa **went** to the supermarket yesterday*
 
 
 
• The **simple past tense,** sometimes called the **preterite**, is used to talk about a completed **action** in a time **before now.** 
 
• The time of the action can be in the recent past or the distant past and action duration is not important.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Gel ingredients work well on waved, curled, **relaxed and textured** hair in the long run.*
